data.name: Gerta
data.gender_notes: Gerta is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'geōrgos' meaning farmer. The name Gerta is a feminine form of this Greek word, and it symbolizes the strong connection between the land and its people. It is also a reminder of the hard work and dedication required to cultivate the earth and produce a bountiful harvest. The name Gerta carries the meaning “Plough, Farmer's Daughter” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gerta usually hope their child will grow to embody plough, farmer's daughter and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Gerta belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Plough, Farmer's Daughter.”
